name: gas_turbine_two_shaft_intercooled_regenerative
title: Land-based two-shaft gas turbine with intercooling, regeneration and reheat
summary: Open-circuit two-shaft gas turbine (Brayton cycle) on air as a perfect gas: low-pressure compressor, water-cooled intercooler, high-pressure compressor, regenerator, main combustion chamber, high-pressure turbine driving the compressors, reheat combustion chamber and low-pressure turbine driving an alternator; computes the LP turbine shaft power and the overall efficiency.
language_features: arrays (state points p[i], h[i], T[i], s[i])
property functions (ideal-gas air and liquid/real water)

authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, course Thermodynamique appliquée)

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (reference/ees_variables.csv of the extraction), compared with tools/compare_solution.py --ees-units
verification.notes: 60 of the 92 common variables (all those that are not an absolute enthalpy or entropy of air) agree within 5.3e-03 relative, the largest deviation being on eta_tg (0.342259 vs 0.344086); every other variable is at or below 3.6e-03. Absolute h and s of air differ by the reference-state offset of the two air models (+126.0 kJ/kg and -1.815 kJ/kg-K); enthalpy differences agree to 2.8e-03 and entropy differences to 2.3e-03. Remaining deviations: the ideal-gas models of air (EES Air vs CoolProp Air).
